en.title: Decimal to Fraction Converter — Coding.Tools
en.description: Convert decimal numbers to fractions directly in your browser.
en.toolDescription: Convert decimal numbers to fraction form (integer, numerator, denominator).
descParas: This tool converts decimal numbers to their fraction representation.
The conversion runs locally in your browser.
steps: Type or paste a decimal number into the input field.
Click Calculate to convert to fraction form.
Use Copy to copy the result.
whatIsParas: Converting decimals to fractions expresses the number as a ratio of two integers. For example, 0.75 = 3/4.
en.inputNotesPara: Enter a valid decimal number. The tool will find the simplest fraction representation.
en.exampleCode:
--- Decimal Input ---
1.75

--- Fraction Output ---
Integer: 1
Numerator: 3
Denominator: 4
